objectives: Solve the Python Lists - Complete Mastery Guide exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Practice Exercises
sections.body:
### Beginner Level

1. Create a list of your favorite movies and perform basic operations (add, remove, search)
2. Write functions to find the maximum, minimum, and average of a list of numbers
3. Implement a function to remove duplicates from a list while preserving order
4. Create a shopping cart system using lists

### Intermediate Level

1. Implement a simple sorting algorithm (bubble sort, insertion sort)
2. Create a matrix calculator with addition, subtraction, and multiplication
3. Build a grade book system that manages student grades using lists of dictionaries
4. Implement a playlist manager with shuffle and repeat functionality

### Advanced Level

1. Create a custom list class that supports undo/redo operations
2. Implement a memory-efficient data pipeline using generators and list operations
3. Build a text analyzer that processes large files using list operations and comprehensions
4. Create a recommendation system using list similarity algorithms

Remember: Practice these concepts regularly and try to use lists efficiently in your real projects. Understanding when to use lists versus other data structures (sets, dictionaries, deques) is crucial for writing efficient Python code!
